scripts.build: bun run build:main && bun run build:renderer
scripts.pack:dir: bun run build:prod && node scripts/stage.mjs && PA_LOCAL_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.build:prod: bun run build:main:prod && bun run build:renderer
scripts.pack:linux: bun run build:prod && node scripts/stage.mjs && PA_LOCAL_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.pack:win: bun run build:prod && PA_TARGET_PLATFORM=win32 PA_TARGET_ARCH=x64 node scripts/stage.mjs && PA_LOCAL_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.pack:mac: bun run build:prod && PA_TARGET_PLATFORM=darwin PA_TARGET_ARCH=arm64,x64 node scripts/stage.mjs && PA_LOCAL_BUILD=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
